title: Fourier expansion of the two-coordinate indicator
statement:
Let $g$ be the indicator of $c$ on the equally weighted set $\{a,b,c\}$, and let $\phi_0,\phi_1,\phi_2$ be the three-point orthonormal Fourier basis. For every $(x_0,x_1)\in\{a,b,c\}^2$,
\[g(x_0)g(x_1)=\sum_{(a_0,a_1)\in\{0,1,2\}^2}\widehat g(a_0)\widehat g(a_1)\,\phi_{a_0}(x_0)\phi_{a_1}(x_1),\]
where $\widehat g(0)=1/3$, $\widehat g(1)=-\sqrt2/6$, and $\widehat g(2)=-\sqrt6/6$.
hypotheses_covered: $(x_0,x_1)$ is a pair of points in the three-point set
